evidence_boundary: Copied immutable Ghidra program memory matches the pinned canonical body digest. Original FileBytes absent; full original XBE was not reauthenticated.

logical_operation.input: Two already-snapshotted raw uint32 words, plus writable byte-buffer pointer. No host float input or arithmetic cast.
logical_operation.conversion: FILD m32int interprets all raw bits as a signed integer. FST/FSTP m32fp retain native x87 rounding and status. Four-output case reloads for +12, +8, then shares one FILD for FST+4/FSTP+0.

original_register_contract.inputs: EAX=input DWORD address; EDX=output address; [entry ESP+4]=selector DWORD address
original_register_contract.snapshot_order: MOV ECX,[EAX] then load selector through stack argument; copy raw input into temporary stack slot.
original_register_contract.outputs: EAX=selector upper24|1; ECX=raw input after final POP, not entry ECX; EDX unchanged.
original_register_contract.cleanup: RET with no immediate, caller owns incoming argument.
original_register_contract.exclusions: Host operation does not implement integer EFLAGS, guest pointer translation, entry/exit GPR transport, or x87 instruction/data-pointer fields.

host_contract: GNU/Clang native x86 x87; all FP exceptions masked; the next push destination ((TOP - 1) mod 8) empty in the x87 tag word; valid output extent. Byte-unaligned output allowed. No C++ FP fallback. Fast math rejected.
tests: Authored native branch oracle, not extracted instruction execution. Compare memory/return/CW/SW/tag/active x87 stack/MXCSR with all 3 PC and 4 RC modes, depths 0/1/4/7, status seeds 0/003f/4700/473f. Exact integer anchors, unaligned output, raw input/output overlap, unchanged sentinels and exact-length guard-page spans.
limits: No full-game behavior, native linkage, Xbox execution or byte-identical rebuild claim.
No original instruction/data pointer parity; memory-fault and unmasked exception recovery excluded.
Original-entry wrapper retains unresolved register pseudo-locals and is syntax-checked, not executed.
No fault/MMIO/observer ordering equivalence claim; exact store order is structurally pinned because same-value stores are not distinguished by final ordinary RAM.
tested_architecture: x86-64 Linux SysV, native Clang/GCC. No 32-bit or other ABI execution claimed.
sanitizer_limits: ASan/UBSan executed with ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0. LeakSanitizer is not tested in this sandbox.
verification_plan: Clang C++17 O0/O2 native oracle and canonical syntax
GCC C++17 O2 ASan+UBSan with leak detection disabled
Original public source reversal, historical failure and narrow-instruction mutation checks
Behavior negatives: raw-float interpretation, wrong selector, wrong byte, lost return bits
Structural negatives: four-output order and paired FST/FSTP order
Harness negative: missing FXRSTOR register clobbers
Isolated operation Clang O0/O2 codegen rejects external memcpy/memory/library calls
harness_review_fixes: FXRSTOR declares all architecture XMM and x87 register clobbers
FNINIT and seed FILD declare all x87 register clobbers
FXSAVE capture objects are uninitialized, avoiding intervening library calls
Live-XMM regression rejects lost FXRSTOR clobbers
The next FILD push destination must be empty, not an arbitrary free slot

compared_fxsave_fields.control_word: bytes 0..1, including exception masks, precision and rounding controls
compared_fxsave_fields.status_word: bytes 2..3, including sticky exception flags, condition bits and TOP
compared_fxsave_fields.abridged_tag_word: byte 4, mapping occupied physical x87 registers
compared_fxsave_fields.active_x87_stack_values: first 10 bytes of each 16-byte logical ST slot, only when its corresponding physical tag is nonempty using TOP
compared_fxsave_fields.mxcsr: bytes 24..27, including SSE rounding/control and exception flags; operation performs no SSE FP arithmetic

excluded_fxsave_fields.instruction_and_data_bookkeeping: FOP bytes 6..7, FIP bytes 8..15, FDP bytes 16..23 differ with native instruction/data addresses; not guest-address emulated
excluded_fxsave_fields.inactive_x87_payloads_and_slot_padding: Empty-tag register contents are not logical stack values; bytes 10..15 of ST storage slots are padding
excluded_fxsave_fields.xmm_register_values: Host compiler may use XMM registers for integer/memory movement; guest SIMD register preservation is part of the excluded ABI bridge
excluded_fxsave_fields.mxcsr_mask: bytes 28..31 describe hardware capabilities rather than operation results
excluded_fxsave_fields.reserved_fields: Not defined logical operation state; comparison does not assert complete FXSAVE image or CPU-context equivalence
